I was anorexic. I nearly died. People challenged my beliefs to save my life. I became anorexic partly *because* I couldn't get help with my gender dysphoria. When I transitioned, my life got better. I was not harmed by transitioning, I was helped. See the difference?

Pre-anorexia, I wouldn't say it was revulsion. More an uncomfortable sense of wrongness. More importantly, now I've transitioned I no longer feel gender dysphoria. I get some problems around weight sometimes, but that is a separate issue these days, no longer tied in with gender.
One of the reasons why I recently tried to end my life was feeling so guilty for taking benefit money. I feel like a parasite and I hate it. Now I'm in hospital taking NHS money 😔
I'm just so grateful to finally feel comfortable in my own body. I had no idea how uncomfortable and wrong I felt until I transitioned! Such a relief, and I'm so much more confident now too.
